summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the new Storico view/edit/save feature and the LeadForm refactor to shared LeadSections. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (2 auth + 6 new GET/PUT single-lead tests including 401 without token, 404 for unknown id, id + created_at preservation on update, spoofed id/created_at rejected, and GET-after-PUT persistence). Frontend E2E via Playwright on the live preview URL passed all 7 scenarios: (1) create-lead flow via LeadForm still works after refactor (Alpha Foods / Giulia / priorita-b / star-rating-4 / lingua-it saved), (2) navigate to /storico + login with buscema2026, (3) click lead-card-<id> opens lead-detail-overlay with all fields prefilled (input-ragione-sociale='Alpha Foods', input-nome-buyer='Giulia', detail-input-nome-fiera='TEST_Cibus_Auto', detail-input-anno='2026'), (4) lead-detail-cancel-btn closes overlay without saving, (5) lead-detail-close (X) closes overlay without saving, (6) editing ragione to 'Alpha Foods MODIFICATA' + priorita-a and clicking lead-detail-save-btn triggers 'Modifiche salvate' toast, closes overlay, and the history list refreshes via onSaved with the updated ragione and A badge, (7) no console errors, no white screen. Test leads cleaned up from MongoDB after the run.
critical_code_review_comments: LeadDetail.jsx handleSave sends the full form back to PUT /api/leads/{id}. Backend correctly overrides id and created_at, but the client-side payload still contains a stale id/created_at from the fetched doc, which is fine but slightly wasteful. Non-blocking.

LeadDetail's useEffect depends on onClose which is a new function reference on every parent render; if History re-renders during load it could re-trigger the GET. In practice History does not, but wrapping onClose in useCallback in History.jsx (or omitting it from the dep array) would be safer.
No DELETE endpoint exists on the API - test data can only be cleaned up via direct DB access. Consider adding DELETE /api/leads/{id} for future admin/testing needs.
server.py update_lead accepts a Lead body which requires all fields; a PATCH-style partial update would be nicer for future partial edits, but current spec is 'full form save' so PUT is acceptable.

Regression note: LeadSections is now shared by LeadForm and LeadDetail - verified both mount without duplicate data-testid collisions because the two views are never mounted at the same time (LeadDetail is a full-screen overlay above History, not above LeadForm).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (added TestLeadGetUpdate class with 6 tests for GET/PUT single lead)
seed_data_creation: Created and then cleaned up: 1 'Alpha Foods' lead via UI (updated to 'Alpha Foods MODIFICATA') + 4 TEST_-prefixed leads via pytest. All 5 removed from MongoDB after the run via direct delete_many on TEST_/MODIFICATA/TEST_Cibus_Auto matches.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py now covers auth, list, filters, single GET, single PUT (with id/created_at preservation), export CSV, and OCR (uses real Emergent LLM key). The Storico view/edit/save feature and the LeadForm->LeadSections refactor are fully working end-to-end. For any future changes to LeadSections, both LeadForm (create) and LeadDetail (edit) must be re-tested since they share the component. No pending bugs.
rca of the issue: N/A - feature verification, no bug to root-cause. All new behavior works as specified: GET /api/leads/{id} auth-gated + returns single lead without _id leakage, PUT preserves id + created_at even when client tries to spoof them, LeadDetail overlay pre-fills all fields from GET, save issues PUT + toast + close + parent fetchLeads refresh, cancel/X buttons close without saving.
